maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from dry bulk ocean freight and logistics charters, not repair or servicing of customers' installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private commercial shippers and commodity traders of dry bulk cargoes such as grain, minerals and DRI.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by operating and expanding its own fleet and logistics services; acquisitions are occasional, such as vessel purchases.

mission_critical.reason: Dry bulk shipping is largely competitive; shippers can switch carriers, though ice-class and port-project niches add some stickiness.
